label: A2 capability profiles with explicit realization and attribution (inference)
rule: Explicit witnesses, domain inclusion, coverage remainder and bridge omission controls
meaning: Analyst A2 profiles: for any relation outgoing capability implies incoming-or-outgoing capability. Guarded accessible exercise and productive stimulus-response dispositions imply one another only under explicit realization and attribution bridges. Broad coverage denial transfers to outgoing coverage denial with an explicit coverage assumption for incoming-only candidates. Finite Bool controls separate both domains, refute unconditional denial transfer in each profile, witness unexercised disposition, omit each cross-profile bridge, and jointly satisfy both bridges. No source meaning is completed or root premise discharged.
